headline: Economy Heats Up, Inflation Breaks 2%, Central Bank Does Not Raise Rates; Yang Chin-lung: K-shaped Economy Must Be Considered | Industry & Economy
summary: The Central Bank of the Republic of China kept rates unchanged for the tenth consecutive meeting and raised its 2026 growth forecast to 11.48%. Full-year CPI rose 2.03%, and Governor Yang Chin-lung flagged the K-shaped economy.
why: Taiwan's central bank sets the island's policy rates, which shape borrowing costs, the New Taiwan dollar and the outlook for its export-heavy economy.
